build: Official enemy, boss, Master Level, and update documentation
observations: Official guidance emphasizes learning enemy-specific defeat rules and readable attack openings.
The Gladiator's second phase preserves counter timing while adding attacks and spatial constraints.
Master Levels remix existing campaign spaces for players who mastered the fundamentals while still scaling to a separately chosen difficulty.
Update 6 separates arsenal reacquisition, extra-life permadeath, and Ultra-Nightmare permadeath into explicit challenge modes.
inferences: Enemy knowledge, encounter composition, resource availability, and persistence are independent difficulty axes.
A later boss phase can escalate by recombining established feedback rather than hiding new rules.
limits: Official guidance does not expose the full AI or encounter-selection implementation.
Published challenge descriptions do not establish preference or fairness for every player.
